summary: Three of six defects found by an independent code-review pass on the sibling classes_detail PR (mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1774) also apply to this branch's pre-classes_detail tree and are ported here. (1) doctor's credentials_location (internal/cli/doctor.go, collectCredentialsLocationReport) treated a bundle-read error identically to "no credentials file exists", reporting "none" either way -- masking a real permissions/corruption problem as an auth setup gap. Now a switch distinguishes err != nil ("unknown (checking persisted bundle failed: ...)") from a genuine absence ("none"). (2) The MCP context tool's field-shape tip (internal/mcp/tools.go) claimed every offline command wraps its result under a "result" key; that's only true for offline_workout (detail/history nesting) -- every other offline command's fields, including "caveats", sit at the top level. Tip text corrected. (3) offlineClass/offlineClasses (internal/cli/offline.go) carried a dead middle fallback tier reading a "catalog_classes" provider_payloads family; grepped across internal/ and confirmed discriminatorDispatchers (sync.go) is empty, so no write path has ever targeted that family name -- removed as genuinely dead code, along with its now-orphaned fixture rows in offline_test.go's seedOfflineFacts. The other three findings from that review (a null-ride merge bug in mergeClassesListItemWithStoredDetail, a --latest-only doc carve-out, and a classSegmentsMissingCaveat wording fix) are classes_detail-exclusive and don't apply to this branch -- see classes-detail-null-ride-and-doc-accuracy-fixes.json on the classes_detail branch for those.
reason: Same independent code-review pass that produced classes-detail-null-ride-and-doc-accuracy-fixes.json on the sibling PR; these three findings touch code shared between both PRs' pre-split trees (doctor.go, tools.go's context-tool tip, and the offlineClass dead-code shape all predate the classes_detail feature), so the fix is ported here rather than left only on the other branch.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test and gofmt all green on this branch after porting. TestDoctorSurfacesBundleCheckErrorDistinctFromNoCredentials (writes an oauth-token.json bundle with an overly-permissive 0o644 mode to trigger loadOAuthBundle's permission-check error path) confirms credentials_location reports the check failure rather than "none".
